newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-AMUNIKE SET TO SIGN FOR BARCELONA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-AMUNIKE SET TO SIGN FOR BARCELONA.

text.p: Sporting's Nigerian international striker Emmanuel Amunike looked set on Monday to become a Barcelona player at the second attempt.
The striker, whose previous transfer to the Spanish side fell through in the summer because of a suspected knee problem, was travelling to Barcelona for fresh tests.
The Catalans, managed by former England coach Bobby Robson, have decided that the player's right knee was not particularly serious, Portuguese newspapers reported on Monday.
Amunike, whose contract with Sporting expires at the end of this season, was confident there would be no problems this time.
"I am happy to play again with my old Sporting colleague, Luis Figo," he told journalists, referring to the Portuguese international midfielder who is in his second season with Barcelona.
Barcelona will pay around $3 million for Amunike, who will sign a four-year contract, according to press reports.
